name: MV Bianca C

sources.title: Scuba Diving — History of Grenada's Bianca C shipwreck: upright off Pink Gin Beach, about 50 m to the bottom, the pools at about 130 ft
Divernet — Mark Evans, Grenada's 'Titanic of the Caribbean': most of the starboard side collapsed onto the seabed, the masts toppled, the superstructure partly fallen in
Advanced Diver Magazine — the Bianca C: on her keel at 167 ft, the fantail broken away, superstructure plates scattered

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q3273207_bianca_c.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. Upright on her keel at about 50 m: the bow and the fire-gutted superstructure, partly fallen in, the funnel with the Costa C, the two pools on the after decks; most of the starboard side collapsed outwards onto the seabed; the fantail broken away and lying a little apart; the masts toppled; plates from the superstructure strewn about; corals and sponges. Heading (not published: 0), the colours and the extent of the collapse are approximate. model_built.glb: the liner as she sailed in 1961.
